description: Related decision actions, with processing, done and unavailable states.

howToUse: Use it for the decision on one item: accept or decline, approve or reject, save or skip.
Handle the choice in `onAction`. While your server answers, set `state` to processing; when it confirms, to done.
Turn off an action that does not apply with `disabledActions`, and say why in `statusMessage`.
alternatives: Deciding item after item by swiping cards: DecisionDeck.

keyboard.action: Runs the action in focus. Nothing happens while it is processing.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
